title: ^PROGRAM DEVELOPMENT AND PROPOSAL WRITING
description: Explores principles of program development, evaluation, and grant writing. Engages students in an iterative drafting, peer and instructor review and revision process to address a social issue relevant to Human Development and Family Sciences.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: HDFS 361.
A minimum grade of C- is required in HDFS 361.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Human Devel and Family Science (447).
